title: The third branch
prompt: Three resistors are in parallel across a 9 V battery. Find the voltage across the third one.
explanation: Branches sharing the same two nodes each get the full 9 V. Voltage only splits in series.

lines: Parallel branches connect to the same two nodes
The voltage splits between branches: 9 / 3 = 3 V each
So the third resistor has 3 V
